briefdescription.para: Stateless collection of checks applied to client JSON before it reaches the database.

detaileddescription.para: This header declares the Validator class: a toolbox of static functions that check JSON sent by a client against the shape of a database table. It also declares the nested Rule type, which lets a caller describe exceptions to the usual checks. None of these functions talks to the database directly; the checks run on an in-memory copy of the schema, so they are cheap enough to run on every incoming request.

WHY THIS FILE MATTERS IN THE SERVER: This is the gatekeeper between the HTTP layer and the database. Entity controllers (for clients, staff, appointments and so on) call these helpers with the parsed request body before they build any SQL. The helpers read the cached schema owned by DatabaseSchema. Without this file, badly shaped or mistyped client data would flow straight into SQL queries and cause errors or security problems, so every create, update and read endpoint depends on it.
